Category A – Settlements with one room pucca houses or tin/bamboo houses with basic amenities



Category B – Settlements with pucca, semi pucca or tin/bamboo/stilt houses mainly on railway land/army land or other government land with basic amenities


Category C – Settlements in private land - rented gated compounds with small rooms primarily made of tin/bamboo with pucca houses only in some pockets. Shared toilets and basic amenities provided by the owners

fields.label: Please specify (Q14)
Eviction Details

fields.description:
Settlements that eventually will face eviction threat: 1. Settlement with close proximity to water bodies (rivers, lakes and canals), railway lines, located above conduit pipes, close to the seashore and road margins. 2. Settlement on railway land or defence land. 3. Settlement on private land. 4. Settlement on temple land.

How to identify if a settlement is facing immediate eviction threat? Lead questions (to be asked only in the above-mentioned categories): 1. Has there been any information about eviction? 2. Any enumeration conducted with or without stating reasons? 3. Any eviction notices issued? 4. Any formal or informal meetings regarding eviction or resettlement conducted? 5. Any pending court case related to eviction?
